## My Cycle 1.3.1

- Restores the owner-approved My Cycle launcher artwork.
- Removes the redrawn VectorDrawable/adaptive launcher replacement introduced in 1.3.0.
- Packages full-frame raster WebP launcher assets for mdpi, hdpi, xhdpi, xxhdpi and xxxhdpi, derived only by resizing the approved PNG with no redesign, tracing, cropping or vectorization.
- Prevents high-density devices from upscaling a single low-resolution launcher asset.
- Adds CI integrity checks for every launcher density and retains built APKs for direct package verification.

No diary data, privacy behavior, permissions or application features are changed in this patch.
